uncited: A 3D radiance field representation (e.g., NeRF) initialized from a set of input images.
Per-view binary masks indicating regions to be inpainted (masked) and regions to be preserved (unmasked).
An optimized 3D radiance field where masked regions are filled with semantically consistent and view-consistent geometry and texture.
*   **Radiance Field Parameters:** Standard NeRF MLP weights or voxel grid densities/colors.
*   **Diffusion Model:** Frozen U-Net parameters for noise prediction $\epsilon_\theta$.
*   **Reconstruction Weight ($\lambda_{rec}$):** Weight for the unmasked region loss.
*   **SDS Weight ($\lambda_{sds}$):** Weight for the masked region loss.
*   **Diffusion Steps:** Number of denoising steps for the 2D inpainter.
**Initialization:** Initialize the 3D radiance field from the input images.
Sample a camera pose and render an RGB image $I_{render}$ from the current radiance field.
Apply the mask $M$ to separate the image into observed ($I_{obs}$) and masked ($I_{mask}$) regions.
Encode the masked region of the rendered image (or the full image with masked region zeroed/padded) into latent space.
Pass the latent through the frozen 2D inpainting diffusion model to predict noise $\epsilon_\theta$.
This gradient signal encourages the rendered masked region to match the distribution of the 2D inpainting model.
where $x_0$ is the reconstructed image from latent $z_t$, and $\theta$ are the radiance field parameters.
**Refinement:** Iterate steps 2-5 until convergence.
*   **View Inconsistency:** Standard 2D inpainting may produce inconsistent textures across views.
Requires multiple forward passes through the radiance field and the diffusion model per iteration.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Moderate to High.
*   **When to use:** When high-fidelity semantic completion is required for large masked regions in 3D scenes.
*   **When not to use:** When real-time performance is critical or when masks are very small and simple geometric interpolation suffices.
It builds on the general framework of Diffusion-Based Guidance for Radiance Field Optimization [8117-diffusion-based-guidance-for-radiance-field-optimization.md].
